join_order.notes: Resolve single k_id by scanning keyword.{off,dat} with length=16 prefilter; use movie_keyword__keyword_id CSR slot to fetch mk rowids directly.
For each t1_id from mk.movie_id, use movie_link__movie_id offsets to iterate ml rows (table sorted by movie_id).
title is dense PK; t2_id - 1 directly addresses title arrays. Same for t1_id - 1.
link_type is dense PK (18 rows); lt_id - 1 addresses link_type.link directly.

filters.notes: Single matching row; length=16 prefilter via off[i+1]-off[i] then memcmp.

parallelism.notes: End-to-end cardinalities are tiny (single rare keyword -> ~10s of mk rows -> ~10s of ml rows). Parallel synchronization overhead dominates any benefit.

indexes.purpose: direct mk rowids for given k_id
ml row range for each t1_id

min_aggregation_details.lt_link: running min of string_view, materialize via link_type.{off,dat} at lt_id-1
min_aggregation_details.t1_title: running min of string_view, materialize via title.{off,dat} at t1_id-1
min_aggregation_details.t2_title: running min of string_view, materialize via title.{off,dat} at t2_id-1
min_aggregation_details.notes: Three independent MINs; varlen slices read only for candidates.
